text: 水光潋滟晴方好，山色空蒙雨亦奇
pinyin: shuǐ guāng liàn yàn qíng fāng hǎo, shān sè kōng méng yǔ yì qí
literal: water · light · rippling · sunny · just · good, mountain · colour · hazy · misty · rain · also · marvellous
natural: the water glitters, best on a sunny day; the hills are misty, marvellous in the rain too

meaning.en: A place is beautiful in every weather and every mood.
meaning.zh: 晴天湖水波光闪闪，雨天山色迷蒙，各有奇妙；形容风景在不同天气下都美。

examples.zh: 杭州游记里写道：“水光潋滟晴方好，山色空蒙雨亦奇”。
examples.en: The Hangzhou travelogue says: '{}'.

examples.zh: 无论晴雨，西湖都是“水光潋滟晴方好，山色空蒙雨亦奇”。
examples.en: Rain or shine, West Lake is '{}'.

story.en: Su Shi wrote this while drinking on West Lake in Hangzhou, on a day that began sunny and turned to rain.
story.zh: 苏轼在杭州西湖饮酒，天气先晴后雨，作此诗赞美湖光山色。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜
pinyin: yù bǎ xī hú bǐ xī zǐ, dàn zhuāng nóng mǒ zǒng xiāng yí
literal: wish · take · West · Lake · compare · Xi Shi, light · make-up · heavy · powder · always · suit
natural: if I compare West Lake to Xi Shi, she suits light make-up and heavy alike

meaning.en: Real beauty looks good however it is dressed, whether plain or elaborate.
meaning.zh: 把西湖比作西施，无论淡妆浓抹都合适；形容天生丽质，怎样打扮都好看。

examples.zh: 她穿什么都好看，真是“欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜”。
examples.en: Whatever she wears looks good: '{}' indeed.

examples.zh: 杭州旅游宣传语引用了“欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜”。
examples.en: The Hangzhou tourism slogan quotes '{}'.

story.en: The second couplet of the same poem compares West Lake to the legendary beauty Xi Shi.
story.zh: 同一首诗的后两句，把西湖比作古代美女西施。

usage.en: Used of the lake, and also of people who look good in any style.
usage.zh: 既指西湖，也可形容人怎样打扮都好看。

text: 竹外桃花三两枝，春江水暖鸭先知
pinyin: zhú wài táo huā sān liǎng zhī, chūn jiāng shuǐ nuǎn yā xiān zhī
literal: bamboo · outside · peach · blossom · three · two · sprays, spring · river · water · warm · duck · first · know
natural: a few sprays of peach blossom beyond the bamboo; the ducks are first to know the spring river is warm

meaning.en: Those closest to a change are the first to sense it.
meaning.zh: 春天江水变暖，鸭子最先察觉；比喻身处其中的人对变化最敏感。

equivalents: those on the spot sense change first

examples.zh: 市场一有风吹草动，经销商最先察觉，正是“竹外桃花三两枝，春江水暖鸭先知”。
examples.en: At the first stirring in the market the dealers are the first to notice, just as "the duck is the first to know when the spring river warms."

examples.zh: “竹外桃花三两枝，春江水暖鸭先知”，一线员工最先感到行业变化。
examples.en: '{}': front-line staff feel industry change first.

story.en: Su Shi wrote this to accompany a painting by the monk Huichong, 'Evening Spring River Scene'.
story.zh: 苏轼为惠崇和尚所画《春江晚景》题诗。

usage.en: The second half is often used on its own for early sensitivity to change.
usage.zh: 常单用后半句，指对变化最敏感。

text: 荷尽已无擎雨盖，菊残犹有傲霜枝
pinyin: hé jìn yǐ wú qíng yǔ gài, jú cán yóu yǒu ào shuāng zhī
literal: lotus · exhausted · already · no · hold · rain · canopy, chrysanthemum · withered · still · has · scorn · frost · branch
natural: the lotus has faded and no longer holds up rain-canopies, but the withered chrysanthemum still has branches that defy frost

meaning.en: In late autumn, when much has faded, some things stay strong; it also encourages hope in hard times.
meaning.zh: 荷叶枯尽，菊花凋残，但仍有傲霜的枝条；勉励人在逆境中保持节操与希望。

equivalents: hold your head high in hard times

examples.zh: “荷尽已无擎雨盖，菊残犹有傲霜枝”，他劝失意的朋友振作。
examples.en: '{}': he urged his dejected friend to pick himself up.

examples.zh: 秋日赏菊，想到“荷尽已无擎雨盖，菊残犹有傲霜枝”。
examples.en: Admiring chrysanthemums in autumn, I thought of '{}'.

story.en: Su Shi sent this poem to his friend Liu Jingwen, a worthy man in poor circumstances, urging him to remember that the best season is early winter.
story.zh: 苏轼赠给怀才不遇的友人刘景文，勉励他看到深秋初冬时节的美好。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥
pinyin: rén shēng dào chù zhī hé sì, yīng sì fēi hóng tà xuě ní
literal: human · life · everywhere · know · what · like, should · like · flying · swan goose · tread · snow · mud
natural: what is life as we wander from place to place? Perhaps a wild goose treading on snowy mud

meaning.en: Life leaves only brief, accidental traces, like a goose's footprints on melting snow.
meaning.zh: 人生各处漂泊，像鸿雁在雪泥上偶然留下爪印，转瞬便无，感叹人生无常。

examples.zh: 整理旧照片，不禁想起“人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥”。
examples.en: Sorting old photos, I could not help recalling '{}'.

examples.zh: “人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥”，漂泊多年，他对这句更有感触。
examples.en: '{}': after years of wandering, this line moves him more.

story.en: Su Shi answered his brother Su Zhe's poem about their past visit to Mianchi, reflecting on how journeys leave only chance traces.
story.zh: 苏轼唱和弟弟苏辙怀念渑池旧游的诗，感叹人生行迹偶然而无常。

usage.en: The image 雪泥鸿爪 comes from this line.
usage.zh: 成语“雪泥鸿爪”即出于此句。

text: 爆竹声中一岁除，春风送暖入屠苏
pinyin: bào zhú shēng zhōng yī suì chú, chūn fēng sòng nuǎn rù tú sū
literal: firecracker · sound · within · one · year · removed, spring · wind · sends · warmth · into · Tusu wine
natural: amid the crackle of firecrackers the old year is seen out; the spring breeze brings warmth into the tusu wine

meaning.en: The scene of Spring Festival: the old year goes out with firecrackers and a warm new one begins.
meaning.zh: 爆竹声中旧年过去，春风把暖意送进屠苏酒；描写除夕与新年的热闹气氛。

equivalents: ring out the old year, ring in spring

examples.zh: 春晚主持人念道：“爆竹声中一岁除，春风送暖入屠苏”。
examples.en: The gala hosts recited: '{}'.

examples.zh: 春联和贺卡上常见“爆竹声中一岁除，春风送暖入屠苏”。
examples.en: '{}' is common on spring couplets and cards.

story.en: Wang Anshi wrote 'New Year's Day' about the Spring Festival customs of firecrackers, tusu wine and replacing peach-wood charms.
story.zh: 王安石《元日》描写春节燃爆竹、饮屠苏酒、换桃符的习俗。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 墙角数枝梅，凌寒独自开
pinyin: qiáng jiǎo shù zhī méi, líng hán dú zì kāi
literal: wall · corner · several · sprays · plum, brave · cold · alone · of itself · bloom
natural: a few sprays of plum blossom in the corner of the wall, braving the cold, bloom alone

meaning.en: Staying true and flourishing quietly despite harsh surroundings.
meaning.zh: 墙角几枝梅花，冒着严寒独自开放；比喻在艰苦环境中坚守品格、默默绽放。

examples.zh: 他在艰苦环境中埋头研究，真是“墙角数枝梅，凌寒独自开”。
examples.en: Working away in hard conditions, he is truly '{}'.

examples.zh: 冬天路过小区，看到“墙角数枝梅，凌寒独自开”的景象。
examples.en: Passing the estate in winter, I saw '{}'.

story.en: Wang Anshi's short poem on plum blossom, written during his later retirement, praises the flower's fortitude and hidden fragrance.
story.zh: 王安石的咏梅小诗，赞美梅花耐寒和暗香。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 遥知不是雪，为有暗香来
pinyin: yáo zhī bù shì xuě, wèi yǒu àn xiāng lái
literal: from afar · know · not · be · snow, because · has · hidden · fragrance · come
natural: from afar I know it is not snow, because a hidden fragrance comes drifting over

meaning.en: Real quality reveals itself by its subtle fragrance, not by its look.
meaning.zh: 远远就知道那不是雪，因为飘来了幽香；比喻真正的品质自会显露。

examples.zh: “遥知不是雪，为有暗香来”，好作品不用吹嘘。
examples.en: '{}': a good work needs no boasting.

examples.zh: 雪后梅园里，游客想起“遥知不是雪，为有暗香来”。
examples.en: In the plum garden after snow, visitors recalled '{}'.

story.en: The closing couplet of the same poem: the white blossom is mistaken for snow, but its scent gives it away.
story.zh: 同一首诗的后两句：白梅似雪，但暗香透露了它的真身。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 不畏浮云遮望眼，自缘身在最高层
pinyin: bù wèi fú yún zhē wàng yǎn, zì yuán shēn zài zuì gāo céng
literal: not · fear · floating · clouds · block · gazing · eyes, since · because · body · is · most · high · level
natural: I do not fear floating clouds that block my view, for I stand on the very highest level

meaning.en: Stand high and see far, and passing obstacles will not cloud your judgement.
meaning.zh: 不怕浮云遮住视线，因为自己站得最高；比喻站得高看得远，不怕被表面现象迷惑。

examples.zh: “不畏浮云遮望眼，自缘身在最高层”，做决策要有大局观。
examples.en: '{}': decisions need a big-picture view.

examples.zh: 他用“不畏浮云遮望眼，自缘身在最高层”勉励青年人志存高远。
examples.en: He used '{}' to urge the young to aim high.

story.en: Wang Anshi wrote this on climbing Feilai Peak at Hangzhou, as a young official full of reformist confidence.
story.zh: 王安石年轻时任地方官，登杭州飞来峰，抒发改革的豪情。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 不以物喜，不以己悲
pinyin: bù yǐ wù xǐ, bù yǐ jǐ bēi
literal: not · because · things · rejoice, not · because · self · grieve
natural: not delighted by outward gains, not saddened by one's own losses

meaning.en: Keep an even mind, unmoved by external circumstances or personal fortune.
meaning.zh: 不因外物好坏而欢喜，不因个人得失而悲伤；保持平静宽广的心境。

equivalents: stay unmoved by gain or loss

examples.zh: 成熟的标志就是“不以物喜，不以己悲”。
examples.en: Maturity means '{}'.

examples.zh: 无论成绩好坏，他都能“不以物喜，不以己悲”。
examples.en: Whatever his marks, he can be '{}'.

story.en: In 'Yueyang Tower', Fan Zhongyan describes the ancient sages' state of mind, unlike visitors swayed by weather and scenery.
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》描述古仁人的心境，与受景物影响而悲喜的人不同。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 居庙堂之高则忧其民；处江湖之远则忧其君
pinyin: jū miào táng zhī gāo zé yōu qí mín, chǔ jiāng hú zhī yuǎn zé yōu qí jūn
literal: dwell · temple · hall · of · height · then · worry · its · people, dwell · rivers · lakes · of · distance · then · worry · its · ruler
natural: in high office at court, he worries for the people; far away in the rivers and lakes, he worries for his ruler

meaning.en: A man of integrity cares for the state whether in high office or in obscurity.
meaning.zh: 无论在朝廷任高官，还是身在偏远民间，都忧虑国事民生。

equivalents: care for the nation in office or out of it

examples.zh: 他一生清廉，“居庙堂之高则忧其民；处江湖之远则忧其君”。
examples.en: He was honest all his life: '{}'.

examples.zh: 史书中常见这种“居庙堂之高则忧其民；处江湖之远则忧其君”的士大夫。
examples.en: Histories often show such scholar-officials, who '{}'.

story.en: From the same essay: Fan describes the sages who worried for the world whatever their position.
story.zh: 出自同文：范仲淹称赞古仁人无论进退都以天下为忧。

usage.en: Formal; followed by 进亦忧，退亦忧.
usage.zh: 书面语，下文接“进亦忧，退亦忧”。

text: 微斯人，吾谁与归
pinyin: wēi sī rén, wú shéi yǔ guī
literal: without · this · kind of person, I · whom · with · return
natural: without such men, with whom should I go?

meaning.en: A call to follow the ideals of such selfless sages, and a lament for their rarity.
meaning.zh: 没有这样的人，我又与谁同道呢？表达对古仁人的追慕和志同道合者难得。

equivalents: without them, whom shall I follow?

examples.zh: 读完他的事迹，不禁感叹“微斯人，吾谁与归”。
examples.en: On reading his story, one can only sigh '{}'.

examples.zh: 文章结尾用“微斯人，吾谁与归”致敬先贤。
examples.en: The article ends with '{}', honouring the sages.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan ends his essay's reflection on the sages' ideals with this line, followed by the dating of the piece.
story.zh: 范仲淹在阐述古仁人之心后，以此句作结，抒发志同道合的向往。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来
pinyin: wú kě nài hé huā luò qù, sì céng xiāng shí yàn guī lái
literal: no · can · do · what · blossoms · fall · go, seems · once · mutually · know · swallows · return · come
natural: I can do nothing as the blossoms fall; swallows return that seem like old acquaintances

meaning.en: Helpless sadness at passing spring and fleeting youth, mixed with a faint feeling of renewal.
meaning.zh: 花落去是无可奈何的事，燕子归来却似曾相识；感叹时光流逝又有一丝循环的慰藉。

equivalents: wistfulness at the passing of spring

examples.zh: 春天快过完了，“无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来”。
examples.en: Spring is nearly over: '{}'.

examples.zh: 老同学重逢，他吟起“无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来”。
examples.en: Meeting old classmates again, he recited '{}'.

origin.source: 晏殊《浣溪沙·一曲新词酒一杯》

story.en: Yan Shu wrote this ci in a leisurely mood, the couplet a famous parallel pair of regret and renewal.
story.zh: 晏殊的闲愁词，此联以对仗工整闻名，寓伤春惜时之感。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路
pinyin: zuó yè xī fēng diāo bì shù, dú shàng gāo lóu, wàng jìn tiān yá lù
literal: last · night · west · wind · wither · green · trees, alone · climb · high · tower, gaze · to the end · heaven · edge · road
natural: last night the west wind stripped the green trees; alone I climb the tall tower and gaze to the end of the road

meaning.en: Stage one of Wang Guowei's three stages of great achievement: loneliness and a clear vision of the goal.
meaning.zh: 王国维称之为成大事业者的第一种境界：孤独中先看清目标与道路。

examples.zh: 王国维把“昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路”比作治学的第一重境界。
examples.en: Wang Guowei likened '{}' to the first stage of scholarship.

examples.zh: 入学第一年，他“昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路”，立志做研究。
examples.en: In his first year he, '{}', resolved to do research.

origin.source: 晏殊《蝶恋花·槛菊愁烟兰泣露》

story.en: Yan Shu's ci describes a woman's longing for an absent traveller; Wang Guowei later reinterpreted the line.
story.zh: 晏殊此词写离愁别恨；王国维后来借此句喻治学的第一境界。

usage.en: Quoted with the next two famous lines (衣带渐宽… and 众里寻他…) as the 'three stages'.
usage.zh: 常与“衣带渐宽”“众里寻他”并称治学三境界。

text: 衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴
pinyin: yī dài jiàn kuān zhōng bù huǐ, wèi yī xiāo de rén qiáo cuì
literal: robe · belt · gradually · loose · in the end · not · regret, for · her/it · wear away · person · haggard
natural: my belt grows ever looser, but I never regret it; for her (or it) I will gladly grow haggard

meaning.en: Devotion that does not regret the toll, in love or in pursuit of a goal.
meaning.zh: 为所爱的人或所追求的事业日渐消瘦也不后悔。

examples.zh: 为了科研，他“衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴”。
examples.en: For his research he lives by '{}'.

examples.zh: 她为了这个项目日夜奋战，真是“衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴”。
examples.en: She works day and night for this project: '{}' indeed.

origin.source: 柳永《蝶恋花·伫倚危楼风细细》

story.en: Liu Yong's ci about lovesickness; Wang Guowei read the couplet as devoted perseverance.
story.zh: 柳永此词写相思之苦，王国维借此句喻为学的执着。

usage.en: In Wang Guowei's scheme, the second stage: toil and devotion.
usage.zh: 王国维以此为治学第二境界：执着投入。

text: 生当作人杰，死亦为鬼雄
pinyin: shēng dāng zuò rén jié, sǐ yì wéi guǐ xióng
literal: alive · should · be · among · people · hero, dead · also · be · among · ghosts · champion
natural: in life be a hero among men; in death be a champion among ghosts

meaning.en: Be heroic in life and remain unyielding even in death.
meaning.zh: 活着要做人中豪杰，死了也要做鬼中英雄。

equivalents: a hero in life and death

examples.zh: 烈士陵园的石碑上刻着“生当作人杰，死亦为鬼雄”。
examples.en: '{}' is carved on the stele at the martyrs' cemetery.

examples.zh: 她用“生当作人杰，死亦为鬼雄”评价这位老英雄。
examples.en: She used '{}' to describe the old hero.

story.en: Li Qingzhao wrote this quatrain after the Song court fled south, praising Xiang Yu who refused to cross the river in defeat.
story.zh: 宋室南渡后，李清照借项羽不肯过江东之事，讽刺当权者苟安。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚
pinyin: xún xún mì mì, lěng lěng qīng qīng, qī qī cǎn cǎn qī qī
literal: seek · seek · search · search, cold · cold · clear · clear, bleak · bleak · wretched · wretched · sorrowful · sorrowful
natural: searching, searching; cold, quiet; bleak, wretched, sorrowful

meaning.en: Overwhelming loneliness and sorrow, expressed through paired words.
meaning.zh: 用叠字写出寻找不得、冷清孤寂、凄凉悲伤的心境。

equivalents: a heart gone empty and cold

examples.zh: 独自在空屋里，他想起“寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚”。
examples.en: Alone in the empty house, he thought of '{}'.

examples.zh: 文章开头引用“寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚”，渲染悲凉气氛。
examples.en: The article opens with '{}' to set a mood of desolation.

origin.source: 李清照《声声慢·寻寻觅觅》

story.en: The famous opening of Li Qingzhao's late ci, written after the fall of the north and the death of her husband.
story.zh: 李清照晚年词的名句开头，国破家亡、丈夫去世后的凄凉心境。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 这次第，怎一个愁字了得
pinyin: zhè cì dì, zěn yī gè chóu zì liǎo de
literal: this · situation, how · one · measure word · sorrow · word · cover
natural: in these circumstances, how could the one word 'sorrow' cover it?

meaning.en: A grief too great for a single word to express.
meaning.zh: 这种光景，哪里是一个“愁”字就能概括的；形容愁绪深重。

equivalents: no word is enough for such grief

examples.zh: 看着满屋狼藉，“这次第，怎一个愁字了得”？
examples.en: Looking at the wrecked house, '{}'?

examples.zh: 她写下“这次第，怎一个愁字了得”，再无下文。
examples.en: She wrote '{}' and nothing more.

origin.source: 李清照《声声慢·寻寻觅觅》

story.en: The closing line of the same ci: after the day's rain, wind and loneliness, Li admits sorrow cannot be summed up.
story.zh: 同一首词的结句：风雨黄昏，孤独难熬，愁绪无法一字概括。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 莫道不消魂，帘卷西风，人比黄花瘦
pinyin: mò dào bù xiāo hún, lián juǎn xī fēng, rén bǐ huáng huā shòu
literal: don't · say · not · lose-soul, curtain · rolled · west · wind, person · than · yellow · flower · thin
natural: do not say it does not break the heart: when the west wind rolls up the curtain, I am thinner than the chrysanthemums

meaning.en: Lovesickness so deep that one grows frailer than the autumn flowers.
meaning.zh: 不要说不销魂，西风卷帘，人比菊花还消瘦；写相思之深。

examples.zh: “莫道不消魂，帘卷西风，人比黄花瘦”，她想念远方的丈夫。
examples.en: '{}': she misses her husband far away.

examples.zh: 重阳节读到这首词，更觉“莫道不消魂，帘卷西风，人比黄花瘦”。
examples.en: Reading this ci at the Double Ninth, the line '{}' felt even more apt.

origin.source: 李清照《醉花阴·薄雾浓云愁永昼》

story.en: Li Qingzhao wrote this to her husband Zhao Mingcheng during a Double Ninth festival while he was away.
story.zh: 重阳佳节，李清照思念在外的丈夫赵明诚，作此词寄去。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 问君能有几多愁？恰似一江春水向东流
pinyin: wèn jūn néng yǒu jǐ duō chóu, qià sì yī jiāng chūn shuǐ xiàng dōng liú
literal: ask · you · can · have · how · much · sorrow, just · like · one · river · spring · water · toward · east · flow
natural: how much sorrow can you have? As much as a river of spring water flowing east

meaning.en: Sorrow that is endless and unstoppable like a flowing river.
meaning.zh: 愁绪像一江春水奔流不息，形容愁多而无尽。

examples.zh: “问君能有几多愁？恰似一江春水向东流”，他用这句词形容思乡之愁。
examples.en: '{}': he used this ci to describe homesickness.

examples.zh: 导游念出“问君能有几多愁？恰似一江春水向东流”，大家都沉默了。
examples.en: The guide read '{}', and everyone fell silent.

origin.source: 李煜《虞美人·春花秋月何时了》

story.en: Li Yu, the captive last ruler of Southern Tang, wrote this ci under house arrest in Song's capital and is said to have been poisoned for it.
story.zh: 南唐后主李煜被囚汴京，作此词寄托亡国之痛，相传因此被赐死。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 春花秋月何时了，往事知多少
pinyin: chūn huā qiū yuè hé shí liǎo, wǎng shì zhī duō shǎo
literal: spring · flowers · autumn · moon · when · end, past · events · know · how · many
natural: spring flowers and autumn moons, when will they end? How many past things do I know

meaning.en: The seasons go on without end, while a person is left remembering a vanished past.
meaning.zh: 春花秋月年年依旧，而往事只剩追忆；感叹岁月无情、物是人非。

equivalents: the seasons go on, the past remains

examples.zh: 老歌响起，“春花秋月何时了，往事知多少”。
examples.en: An old song plays: '{}'.

examples.zh: 毕业十年，同学聚会，不禁想起“春花秋月何时了，往事知多少”。
examples.en: Ten years after graduation at a reunion, one thinks of '{}'.

origin.source: 李煜《虞美人·春花秋月何时了》

story.en: The opening of Li Yu's last ci, contrasting nature's cycle with his memories of the lost kingdom.
story.zh: 李煜此词的开篇，以自然循环对比自己的亡国之思。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 剪不断，理还乱，是离愁。别是一般滋味在心头
pinyin: jiǎn bù duàn, lǐ hái luàn, shì lí chóu, bié shì yī bān zī wèi zài xīn tóu
literal: cut · cannot · break, sort · yet · tangled, is · parting · sorrow, special · is · one · kind · taste · in · heart · head
natural: cut it and it will not break; sort it and it tangles again: this is the sorrow of parting, a flavour unlike any other at the heart

meaning.en: A knotted, inescapable sorrow of separation that cannot be sorted out.
meaning.zh: 离愁像丝线剪不断、理更乱，别有一番滋味在心头。

equivalents: a tangle of feeling that can't be undone

examples.zh: “剪不断，理还乱，是离愁。别是一般滋味在心头”，他对这段感情说不清。
examples.en: '{}': he could not put this relationship into words.

examples.zh: 朋友远行，我心里“剪不断，理还乱，是离愁。别是一般滋味在心头”。
examples.en: With my friend leaving, my heart is '{}'.

origin.source: 李煜《相见欢·无言独上西楼》

story.en: Written by Li Yu in captivity, standing alone on the west tower in the autumn night with the moon like a hook.
story.zh: 李煜被囚期间，月夜独上西楼，抒写亡国离愁。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Often shortened to 剪不断，理还乱 for tangled feelings or problems.
usage.zh: 常缩为“剪不断，理还乱”，形容纷乱的心绪或关系。

text: 林花谢了春红，太匆匆。无奈朝来寒雨晚来风
pinyin: lín huā xiè le chūn hóng, tài cōng cōng, wú nài zhāo lái hán yǔ wǎn lái fēng
literal: forest · flowers · fade · particle · spring · red, too · hurried, helpless · morning · comes · cold · rain · evening · comes · wind
natural: the forest blossoms have shed their spring red, so hastily; helpless against the cold rain of morning and the wind of evening

meaning.en: Beauty and youth fade too quickly, battered by hardship that one cannot resist.
meaning.zh: 林中春花匆匆凋谢，又遭晨雨晚风；感叹美好事物易逝、人生多磨难。

examples.zh: 看着满地落花，他吟道：“林花谢了春红，太匆匆。无奈朝来寒雨晚来风”。
examples.en: Watching the fallen blossoms, he chanted: '{}'.

examples.zh: “林花谢了春红，太匆匆。无奈朝来寒雨晚来风”，青春易逝。
examples.en: '{}': youth passes quickly.

origin.source: 李煜《相见欢·林花谢了春红》

story.en: Li Yu's ci on spring fading, widely read as a metaphor for his own fall from power.
story.zh: 李煜以春花凋谢写人生无常，亦寄托个人的亡国之痛。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 流水落花春去也，天上人间
pinyin: liú shuǐ luò huā chūn qù yě, tiān shàng rén jiān
literal: flowing · water · fallen · flowers · spring · gone · particle, heaven · above · human · world
natural: water flows, blossoms fall, spring is gone: heaven above, the human world below

meaning.en: The loss of spring and of former glory, so far apart that the past seems another world.
meaning.zh: 流水落花，春天逝去；昔日与今日如天上人间，相隔悬殊。

equivalents: the glory that was has gone for ever

examples.zh: “流水落花春去也，天上人间”，故乡早已面目全非。
examples.en: '{}': my hometown is no longer recognisable.

examples.zh: 夏天来临，春已去，不禁念起“流水落花春去也，天上人间”。
examples.en: With summer here and spring gone, one thinks of '{}'.

origin.source: 李煜《浪淘沙·帘外雨潺潺》

story.en: One of Li Yu's last ci, written in captivity, mourning the vanished kingdom through the image of spring passing.
story.zh: 李煜晚期词作，以春去花落比喻故国难再。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 两情若是久长时，又岂在朝朝暮暮
pinyin: liǎng qíng ruò shì jiǔ cháng shí, yòu qǐ zài zhāo zhāo mù mù
literal: two · hearts · if · are · long-lasting · time, also · how · lie · morning · morning · evening · evening
natural: if two hearts are true for a long time, why should they need to be together every morning and evening?

meaning.en: True love lasts through separation; it does not depend on being together every day.
meaning.zh: 真挚的感情长久不变，就不必朝夕相守；常用于七夕和异地恋。

examples.zh: 异地恋的他们互相打气：“两情若是久长时，又岂在朝朝暮暮”。
examples.en: The long-distance couple encouraged each other: '{}'.

examples.zh: 七夕的祝福里常有“两情若是久长时，又岂在朝朝暮暮”。
examples.en: '{}' often appears in Qixi messages.

story.en: Qin Guan's ci retells the cowherd and weaver girl legend, who meet once a year across the Magpie Bridge.
story.zh: 秦观写牛郎织女七夕鹊桥相会的传说，赞美忠贞长久的爱情。

usage.en: Often quoted at Qixi (Double Seventh) and in love messages; the preceding line is 金风玉露一相逢，便胜却人间无数.
usage.zh: 常用于七夕和情感祝福，上句为“金风玉露一相逢，便胜却人间无数”。
